rules.description: CCPA/CPRA time to respond to requests to know, correct and delete (Civ. Code 1798.130, 1798.145(h))

extension.grounds: when reasonably necessary, taking into account the complexity and number of the requests

source.title: California Consumer Privacy Act (CPPA-published statute text, effective 1 January 2025), Civ. Code 1798.130(a)(2) and 1798.145(h)

versions.notes: 1798.130(a)(2)(A): disclose, correct or delete 'within 45 days of receiving a verifiable consumer request'; verification 'shall not extend' that duty; the period 'may be extended once by an additional 45 days when reasonably necessary, provided the consumer is provided notice of the extension within the first 45-day period'. 1798.145(h)(1): extension 'by up to a total of 90 days', informing the consumer within 45 days 'together with the reasons for the delay'. The employee-data exemption in 1798.145(m) became inoperative on 1 January 2023, hence effectiveFrom. leginfo.legislature.ca.gov refused automated access (bot challenge); text checked in the statute PDF published by the California Privacy Protection Agency.

rules.description: California security breach notification (Civ. Code 1798.82) — partially verified

regulator.standard: electronically submit a single sample copy of the security breach notification, excluding personally identifiable information

individuals.standard: notify any California resident whose unencrypted personal information was, or is reasonably believed to have been, acquired by an unauthorized person

source.title: California Attorney General — Submit Data Security Breach (Civ. Code 1798.82(a), (f))

versions.notes: Verified on the Attorney General's page: residents must be notified (1798.82(a)); a breach requiring notice to 'more than 500 California residents' requires a sample copy to the Attorney General (1798.82(f)). The statutory timing (including the 2025 amendment reported as SB 446) and the duty of a business maintaining data it does not own could not be verified: leginfo.legislature.ca.gov refused automated access. Legal review must confirm before relying on any deadline (HUMAN_TODO 3.4). Modelling baseline 2024-01-01.
